title: Limburgish
description: South/Eastern branch of Low Franconian spoken in and around Limburg
extract: Limburgish is the collective designation for a group of closely related language varieties spoken in most of Belgian and Dutch Limburg and in the adjacent areas of North Rhine-Westphalia.
extract_html: Limburgish is the collective designation for a group of closely related language varieties spoken in most of Belgian and Dutch Limburg and in the adjacent areas of North Rhine-Westphalia.
